subject: Heal Potion
text: Heal Potions cost 60 GP, restoring a random amount of HP during battle and 30 HP on the field.

evidence.quote:
Heal Potion
Cost: 60 GP
Effect: Use it while fighting or on the field to restore your HP. I do
believe that it will restore a random amount while fighting, otherwise
it will always restore 30 on the field.

subject: Pure Potion
text: Pure Potions cost 75 GP and can be used on the field or during battle to remove the poison status effect.

evidence.quote:
Pure Potion
Cost: 75 GP
Effect: Use this potion to remove the negative status effect of Poison.
It can be used while fighting or on the field.

subject: Soft Potion
text: Soft Potions cost 800 GP and remove the Stone status from a warrior, but cannot be used during combat.

evidence.quote:
Soft Potion
Cost: 800 GP
Effect: This potion will remove the Stone status from on of your
warriors. This potion unlike the Heal and Pure Potions cannot be
used while fighting.

subject: Tent
text: A Tent costs 75 GP, saves the game on the world map, and restores 30 HP to all warriors.

evidence.quote:
Tent
Cost: 75 GP
Effect: Use the tent on the world map to save your game, and restore 30
HP to your warriors. This cannot be used in dungeons, towers or caves.

subject: Cabin
text: A Cabin costs 250 GP, saves the game on the world map, and restores 60 HP to all warriors.

evidence.quote:
Cabin
Cost: 250 GP
Effect: Using the cabin on the world map will allow you to save your
game, and it will also restore 60 HP to all your warriors. Again you
cannot use this anywhere else other than the world map.

subject: House
text: A House costs 3,000 GP, saves the game on the world map, and restores 120 HP and all magic.

evidence.quote:
House
Cost: 3,000 GP
Effect: The house works in the same way as the Tent and Cabin, allowing
you to save your game on the world map. It also restores 120 HP and all
your Magic. Like the previous two items, the House must be used on the
world map, and will not work anywhere else.

subject: Adamant
text: The Adamant is found in the Sky Castle and can be brought to the Dwarven Blacksmith to forge the Excalibur (Xcalber).

evidence.quote:
Adamant
Location: Sky Castle
Use: Bring the Adamant to the Dwarven Blacksmith, and he will use it to
for the Xcalber for you.

subject: Airship
text: The Airship is obtained by using the Floater in the Ryukhan Desert south of Crescent Lake.

evidence.quote:
Airship
Location: Ryukhan Desert
How to obtain: Once you have the Floater (see below) head to the
Ryukhan Desert just south of Crescent Lake, and use the floater there.

subject: Bottle
text: The Bottle can be purchased for 50,000 GP at the Oasis desert west of Onrac.

evidence.quote:
Bottle
Location: Oasis, the small desert west of Onrac
Use: Pay the 50,000 GP for the bottle and bring it back to the town of
Gaia, and head behind the town, to find the spring.

subject: Canoe
text: The Canoe is obtained in Crescent Lake from the twelve sages after defeating Lich, allowing travel across lakes, rivers, and streams.

evidence.quote:
Canoe
Location: Crescent Lake
How to Obtain: Travel to Crescent Lake after you defeat Lich and talk
to the twelve sages there. With the Canoe, you can now travel across
lakes, rivers, and streams.

subject: Chime
text: The Chime is obtained from an NPC in southeastern Lefein after bringing the Slab to Dr. Unne to learn Lefeinish.

evidence.quote:
Chime
Location: Lefein
How to Obtain: After you bring the Slab back to Dr. Unne and learn to
speak Lefeinish, head to the town of Lefein, and talk to the person in
the southeastern corner of the town, to recieve it.

subject: Crown
text: The Crown is obtained in the depths of the Marsh Cave after defeating the Wizards.

evidence.quote:
Crown
Location: Marsh Cave
How to Obtain: Work your way down through the Marsh Cave, and defeat
the Wizards for the Crown, and bring it back to Astos.

subject: Crystal
text: The Crystal is won by bringing the Crown to Astos at his castle and defeating him.

evidence.quote:
Crystal
Location: Astos' Castle
How to Obtain: After bringing the Crown back to Astos, he will attack
you. Defeat him and you'll win the Crystal.

subject: Cube
text: The Cube is obtained by talking to the robot inside the Waterfall treasure room.

evidence.quote:
Cube
Location: Waterfall
How to Obtain: Make your way through the Waterfall maze, and talk to
the robot at the treasure room there, and it will give you the Cube.

subject: Floater
text: The Floater is found in the Ice Cave after defeating the Eye, and is brought to the Ryukhan Desert to raise the Airship.

evidence.quote:
Floater
Location: Ice Cave
How to Obtain: Work your way through the Ice Cave (not an easy task)
and defeat the Eye for the Floater, and then try to get out again, (an
even harder task than getting in) and bring it to the Ryukhan Desert
for the Airship (see above).

subject: Herb
text: The Herb is traded by Matoya in Matoya's Cave in exchange for returning the Crystal won from Astos.

evidence.quote:
Herb
Location: Motoya's Cave
How to Obtain: Bring the Crystal back to Motoya which you earned after
defeating Astos, and Motoya will trade you the Herb for the return of
the Crystal.
